title: Sessions
subtitle: Your browsers and your agents’. Watch one to see it live and take control.
empty.persistent: A persistent session keeps its logins from one use to the next.
empty.agents: Your agents’ sessions show up here too.
leftovers: {count} leftover files could not be removed. easi.run tries again at its next start; its log says why.
start.title: New browser session
start.subtitle: A private Chrome your agents can use and you can watch.
resume.title: Resume “{name}”
resume.subtitle: Opens it with the logins and settings it saved.
start.forgotten: The proxy it last browsed through was deleted: it browses from this server unless you pick another.
start.persistent.help: Keeps logins and history for next time, encrypted.

start.persistent.full.one: At most {count} saved session: delete one first.
start.persistent.full.other: At most {count} saved sessions: delete one first.

name: Name
start.devtools.help: It can run scripts on the page and read anything on it. Sites may notice.
start.forAgent.help: Whoever opens this session watches until they take control.
error.locked: Saved sessions are locked: unlock them under Saved with your password.
error.unstarted: “{name}” is saved, but its browser did not start: {why} Resume it under Saved, or delete it.
saved.none: None yet. Turn on Persistent when you start a session to keep its logins for next time.
locked.text: A passkey sign-in does not unlock them. Enter your password once; they stay unlocked until the server restarts.
unlock.title: Unlock saved sessions
unlock.subtitle: Once after each server restart, when you signed in with a passkey.
unlock.password.help: The password you sign in with. It unlocks your saved sessions.
agents.local.help: May start it, through admin mcp.
agents.token.help: May start it, with its token.
delete.confirm: Delete “{name}”? Its saved logins and site data are deleted for good.
start.persistent.unlock: Saved sessions are locked. Type your password to unlock them.
start.proxy.help: Websites see the proxy's location, not this server's.
discard.confirm: Delete the session at {name}? Its browser closes, and nothing of it is kept.
start.feature.keyboard_pointer.help: Use the page with mouse and keys.
start.feature.clipboard.help: Text to and from your computer.
start.feature.uploads.help: Into the page, yours or the agent's.
start.feature.downloads.help: From the page, to you or the agent.
start.feature.sound.help: Its sound, live, in your browser.
start.feature.recording.help: A video, saved to your Downloads.
start.feature.replay.help: Nothing is recorded while you have control.
